direct_reply_pairs.rationale: Darwin explicitly acknowledges embryonic-leaf note and answers the distinctive cotyledon/placenta/amnios comparison with qualified seed-shape and larval-environment explanations.

evidence.quote: the Cotyledonary may be regarded as placenta? Amnios?
Thanks for your interesting note about embryonic leaves
I am not learned enough in animal embryology to compare cotyledons with amnios
If cotyledons have a relation to the external conditions of existence

direct_reply_pairs.incoming_scope: Surviving 2114 botanical discussion before George Henslow passage; missing ending and undated Darwin annotation excluded.
direct_reply_pairs.response_scope: 2116 P2–3. Visit/religion remarks P1 depend on missing material; Gray P4 is separate knowledge.
direct_reply_pairs.response_date_policy: July 1, supplied 1857. Preserve original Hooker June 28 versus editorial Saturday June 27 correction.

correspondent_replies.rationale: Hooker thanks exact embryonic-furze specimens and addresses Darwin proposed comparison with animal embryos using other juvenile-leaf cases.

evidence.quote: feebly analogous to embryonic resemblances in young animals
Many thanks for the Embryonic Furze.

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 2114 P1 botanical section before George Henslow news answers 2112 P1; missing ending not recovered.

correspondent_replies.rationale: Hooker gives the requested news of grieving Henslow and family and acknowledges Darwin affectionate words about Harriet.

evidence.quote: I shd. like much to have ever so short a scrap to tell me how Henslow is.
Old Henslow was very much cut up
all spoke lovingly of her, as you did.

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 2178 P1–2 answers 2174 sympathy and request. No claim full letter was forwarded or a separate Darwin-to-Henslow note survives.
correspondent_replies.response_date_policy: November 21 conditional illness letter precedes Hooker Wednesday assigned December 2 death report. Actual November 20 death does not activate Darwin knowledge before evidence.

cross_correspondent_knowledge.rationale: Darwin tells Hooker he has another Gray letter and repeats the exact 132-tree, 95-separated-sexes calculation from the June 1 source.

evidence.quote: Out of 132 trees, those with separated flowers more or less—are 95.
I have had another letter from Asa Gray
out of 132, 95 have sexes more or less separate (= .72)

cross_correspondent_knowledge.knowledge_scope: At least Gray tree-sex result read by July 1; exact arrival and earliest other witness require cumulative reconciliation.

cross_correspondent_knowledge.rationale: Darwin reports a gardener reply to his kidney-bean notice and a remarkable mixed bean lot, matching Coe November 4 letter and samples.

evidence.quote: I enclose a few beans they are from the “Black Negro”.
Such a mixture, I never before met with
My notice in G. Ch. on kidney Beans has brought me a curious letter from intelligent Gardener, with a most remarkable lot of Beans

cross_correspondent_knowledge.knowledge_scope: Coe November 4 letter and mixed samples known by November 14 Darwin witness. Coe November 14 reply refers to missing Darwin November 13 thanks, an earlier indirect clue; its new answers are not activated in the same-day Hooker letter.

proposal_adjudications.reason: Both endpoints are Darwin outgoing; actual incoming Hooker challenge is missing.

2124 is related seedling follow-up but explicitly acknowledges a missing current reply to July5query. Shared juvenile-leaf subject alone does not identify June27 letter as specific prompt; secure June27→July1relation accepted separately.

reference_observations.description: Original div.cdnotes is empty despite footnotes 11–15 referring to DAR 114:222c. Full query list unavailable; footnote 14 Linum excerpt remains separately attributed. Candidate public search found no complete body.
Gregorian calendar: October 23 and 30, 1857 were Fridays; October 31 was Saturday. Footnote rationale does not uniquely select 23; raw date kept and exact-day export held.
Six verified fractions: 134/1000, 97/1000, 150/1000, 114/1000, 160/1000, 105/1000. Cohort thresholds and raw layout retained. Godron citation is actually Boreau according to apparatus.
6¾ oz mud, not 634 oz. Full separate horse-question enclosure is Darwin September 11 prose and not reply content.
Sixteen MathML fractions verified: 1/13, 1/10, 1/8, 1/10, 1/10, 1/60, 1/13, 1/8, 1/24, 1/18, 1/29, 1/52, 1/43, 1/43, 1/43, 1/11. Preserve introduced/indigenous columns and tree-family key.
Place footnote number 1 adjoins actual 4th November date in header projection; original opener_date confirms November 4, not November 14.
June 3 female-head example absent from incomplete surviving Wollaston text; editorial reference alone cannot supply missing passage.
Primary confirms local 2156 empty section without claiming universal absence. Candidate claim that October 23 is independently best established by Friday rationale is not accepted.

corrections.description: First pass missed explicit 2114 cotyledon response; accept 2116 P2–3, excluding missing religious discussion.
Body says 100 Indian Impatiens species and few extra-Indian species, not strictly endemic and over 100. Later 1859 variation claim not backdated.
Actual death date is not Darwin knowledge date; November 21 body remains conditional.

summary: Seventeen targets and five additional sources independently read in full; three contexts reused. One Darwin direct reply, two Hooker reverse replies and two Gray/Coe knowledge witnesses. Two first-pass proposals rejected; missing query list, incomplete prompts, calendar hold and actual leaf drawing preserved.
